hero.desc: Pharmatrack igufasha kubona vuba amafarumasi hafi aho kandi afite imiti wandikiwe. Izigame igihe, wirinde ingendo zidakenewe, kandi ubone imiti ukeneye vuba.

about.quote: Mfite umuti nandikiwe, ariko sinzi farumasi ifite uwo muti.
about.label: KUKI PHAMATRACK?
about.p1: Mu Rwanda, kubonana na muganga akakwandikira  imiti ni igice kimwe gusa cy’urugendo. Ikindi gice ni ukuzenguruka muri za farumasi zitandukanye, wizeye ko wenda imwe muri zo yaba ifite umuti nyawo muganga wawe yanditse.
about.p2: Twashyizeho Pharmatrack kugira ngo abarwayi n’imiryango yabo badakomeza gukeka aho imiti yabo iri. Ushobora kumenya neza farumasi ifite imiti yawe n’aho iherereye, mbere y’uko uva kwa muganga.
